description: Change one brand kit's name, guidance text, voice settings, or kit writing rules, and optionally publish it, under the same rules as the Brand Profile page. Call get_brand_kit first. Edits save to the kit's draft; content generation keeps using the published version until publish is true, which creates a new immutable version (the Brand Profile page can restore earlier ones). A guidance entry without find replaces the whole field with text (empty text clears it); with find, text replaces that passage, which must occur exactly once in the field text get_brand_kit returned (empty text deletes it). Voice settings take 1-5 or "auto"; omitted settings keep their value. Rules: add new ones, update by id (omitted fields keep their value; category "" clears it), or remove by id. Kit rules need the writing rules feature on the plan. A rule that contradicts an existing kit or global rule is refused with the explanation and nothing is saved; a rename to a name another kit uses is refused. When the result says the kit changed in another session, call get_brand_kit again and retry. outcome saved_publish_failed means the draft was saved but not published; publish_error says why. Global writing rules are changed with update_global_rules, not here.

guidance.description: Guidance text changes, one entry per field. Without find, text replaces the whole field (empty text clears it). With find, text replaces that passage (empty text deletes it).

field.description: voice is the writing direction; the others are audience, perspective (point of view), author (author guidance), terminology, channel (format and channel), locale (language and locale), disclosures (claims and disclosures).

find.description: A passage to replace with text, copied exactly from the field text get_brand_kit returned; it must occur exactly once. Omit it to replace the whole field.

text.description: The new text. Markdown paragraphs, headings, bullets and numbered items are kept as structure.

kit_id.description: The brand kit, from get_brand_kit's available_kits.

name.description: A new name, unique on the website.

publish.description: true publishes the saved draft as a new version, which content generation uses from then on. Only when the user asked to publish.

rules.description: Writing rules to add, update by id, or remove by id. Ids come from get_brand_kit.

category.description: A short grouping label; "" clears it.

text.description: One writing rule, as an instruction to the writer.

update.description: By id; omitted fields keep their value.

category.description: A short grouping label; "" clears it.

is_active.description: false keeps the rule but stops applying it.

text.description: One writing rule, as an instruction to the writer.

voice_settings.description: Each 1 (formality: casual, expression: reserved, humor: serious, stance: neutral, technicality: plain) to 5 (formal, expressive, playful, opinionated, technical), or "auto" to let the writer decide. Omitted dimensions keep their value.

name: update_brand_kit

items.description: voice is the writing direction; the others are audience, perspective (point of view), author (author guidance), terminology, channel (format and channel), locale (language and locale), disclosures (claims and disclosures).
